title: mtx_circular_harmonics
description: `mtx_circular_harmonics` evaluates circular harmonics at points specified by phi coordinates, producing a matrix suitable for uses such as 2D Ambisonic encoding. Its required numerical creation argument sets the maximum order (`nmax`), and an optional normalization mode can be selected, with N2D as the default and SN2D noted as a typical 2D Ambisonic choice.
